event.description: Share one input column of the second attention output map across depth
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2739 parameters at 99.7000%, a +0.70 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0070, sharing three query output rows across depth at 2739 parameters and 99.70%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0073, sharing one output row of head 1 at 2732 parameters and 94.33%; prior attempts in this family: 20. Hypothesis: the failed output-row tie may overconstrain a whole coordinate, so preserve the full output dimensionality and share only one 7-value input-column vector of head 1's otherwise independent 7x7 map across depth, with the remaining six input columns block-specific. This removes 7 parameters for a target of 2732. It is more informative than repeating the row tie because it tests the complementary axis of the same post-attention map at identical parameter savings and distinguishes coordinate redundancy from feature-direction redundancy. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, ff23 with one within-block tied hidden unit shared across blocks, rank8 positions, two final group scales, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
